feature.label: OFFICIAL
feature.headline: Try Before You Buy: Game Passes Get Free Trials
feature.dek: From December 2, some passes can be borrowed for a whole session. Your wallet gets a day off.
paras: Roblox announced Pass Free Trials on November 18. Creators can switch them on now in Creator Hub under Monetization, Shop, Free Trials, and players start seeing them on December 2, but only in a game's in-game Shop and only for passes whose creator opted in.

A trial lasts a full game session and at least an hour. Each player gets one trial per pass, and only one trial at a time. So yes, you can finally find out whether the 2x Speed pass was worth it before it is too late.

sources.title: Roblox DevForum, Introducing Pass Free Trials

stories.headline: Bank Of America Says Wait For The Dust
stories.dek: Target up to $48, rating still Neutral. GTA VI may take about 2% of Roblox playtime.
paras: Bank of America analysts Omar Dessouky and Arthur Chu raised their Roblox target to $48 from $45 on November 19 and kept a Neutral rating, telling investors to wait for the GTA VI dust to settle. They estimate about 13% of Roblox players are realistic GTA VI buyers and assume 40% of those buy it.

Their math has GTA VI taking about 2% of Roblox playing hours this quarter, and they trimmed their fourth-quarter bookings estimate to $1.90 billion from $1.95 billion. Roblox's CFO said in October the company has limited data to size the impact. Everyone is guessing, just with spreadsheets.

stories.headline: Citi Stops Cheering, Starts Watching
stories.dek: Downgraded to Neutral. Reasons: fading eggs, no new mega-hit, and GTA VI.
paras: Citi analyst Jason Bazinet downgraded Roblox to Neutral from Buy on November 13 and kept a $55 price target. He pointed to fading interest in Steal An Egg, no new hit game to replace it, and the arrival of GTA VI.
The average analyst target has fallen from $146 a year ago to $50 now. Eight days later, Steal An Egg pulled 6.9 million players at once with a turkey. Timing is everything.

stories.headline: Your Avatar Can Now Sell Its Outfit
stories.dek: Avatar Moments turn a pose into a short video with a Shop button.
paras: Roblox announced Avatar Moments on November 20. Players aged 16 and up can turn their avatar into a short video with an emote, a background and optional text and music, then post it to their profile. Viewers can tap Shop to try on the items and buy them.
Item creators get their usual 30% on those sales. It is rolling out gradually, and Roblox says more shoppable Moments are coming in 2027. The runway is open. The runway is also a shop.

stories.headline: Steal An Egg Makes $40M+ In Three Months
stories.dek: Turns out watching ads to hatch eggs faster is a business model.
paras: Roblox's biggest game of the year has brought in more than $40 million from in-game purchases and advertising over the past three months, Bloomberg reports. Players can watch ads to hatch their eggs faster, and that's exactly the kind of game Roblox wants for its growing ads business.
It averaged 1,341,295 players in October, down 26% on September, and then its Turkey Takeover update pulled a peak of 6,903,927 on November 21. The turkey is now the most valuable bird in gaming.

up.headline: Dandy's World Fills Every Floor
up.dek: The 1.0 launch pulled 788,603 players at once, close to the game's all-time high.
paras: BlushCrunch Studio's Dandy's World left alpha on November 20 and hit a peak of 788,603 players at once over the weekend, per Rolimons. Its all-time record is still 866,577, set on April 18, 2025. On Monday morning 182,515 were playing.

Bloxodes has the game up 130.6% in seven days. The 1.0 update added the Labs, a harder new mode with more than 10 new floors, a card system and a lot of new lore, and the release event runs until November 30. The Toons have never been this busy.

up.headline: Anime Crusaders Powers Up
up.dek: Up 286.8% in a week. Somebody yelled very loudly before attacking.
paras: Anime Crusaders by 32x had 85,800 players at once on Bloxodes' trending list, up 286.8% in seven days and 22.1% in a day. That made it the ninth-biggest game on the list, just ahead of RIVALS.
It is the biggest weekly jump in Bloxodes' top 10. Anime games on Roblox take a long time to charge up. This one seems to have finished.

up.headline: Adopt Me Gets Adopted Again
up.dek: Up 36.5% in a week to 294,200 players, second only to Steal An Egg.
paras: Uplift Games' Adopt Me had 294,200 players at once on Bloxodes' trending list, up 36.5% in seven days, putting it second behind Steal An Egg and ahead of Brookhaven RP.
It averaged 227,629 players in October, up about 75,000 on September, per Bloxodes. The pets have been around since 2017. They are not going anywhere, mostly because they cannot open the door.

up.headline: Hyper Realistic Ragdoll Falls Upward
up.dek: Made October 29. Top 10 on Roblox three weeks later. Gravity is the main character.
paras: Hyper Realistic Ragdoll by Emo Playworks was created on October 29 and ranked 10th on Roblox's Top Playing chart on November 18 with 64,906 players, per GGRecon. Each server holds one player, so that is 64,906 people falling over alone.

GGRecon counted four ragdoll and crash-physics games, all made in October or November, with 173,624 players between them. Roblox players have discovered falling over, and they are not getting back up.

sources.title: GGRecon, new games on the charts (Nov 18)

down.headline: Blox Fruits Is Getting A Little Bruised
down.dek: Down about 137,000 players a month, then another 24.6% this week.
paras: Gamer Robot Inc's Blox Fruits averaged 174,003 players in October, about 137,000 fewer than September, per Bloxodes. It is still a top-five game with 221,400 playing on Bloxodes' trending list, but down 24.6% over seven days.
Still bigger than almost everything on Roblox. Just a little less fresh than it used to be. Check the fruit bowl.

down.headline: DONT SPLASH Splashed Anyway
down.dek: The fastest-growing new game of early November lost about three quarters of its players.
paras: DONT SPLASH by Bacon Theory topped GGRecon's fastest-growing new games list on November 2 with 161.9 million visits, about 9.7 million a day, and 97,140 people playing. On November 18 it had 25,529 on the Top Playing chart.
That is a drop of about 74% in 16 days. The game asked one thing of its players. They splashed.

sources.title: GGRecon, new games on the charts (Nov 18)

stories.headline: Studio Learns To Copy, Paste And Think
stories.dek: Animation Graph state machines go live, and instances copy as JSON.
paras: Roblox moved State Machines and Luau Expressions in Animation Graphs to full release on November 19, so animations can switch between states by rules instead of a pile of scripts. The same week brought copying and pasting instances as JSON in Studio, and a new API to read which region a game server is in.
Web Play also switched to WebGPU for sharper graphics in the browser, per Roblox's weekly recap. Your animations now have a brain. Please do not let them unionize.

sources.title: DevForum, Copy and Paste as JSON

stories.headline: Your UI Can Sparkle Now
stories.dek: ParticleEmitter2D lands in Studio Beta. Buttons everywhere are about to get very excited.
paras: Roblox's UI Particles beta adds ParticleEmitter2D, which you put under any GUI object to get sparkles, bursts and glows. You control texture, color, transparency, size, speed, drag and spin, with flipbook animation and an Emit() call for one-off bursts.
Turn it on under File, Beta Features, UI Particles. Places that use it can't be published while it's in beta, so sparkle responsibly.

stories.headline: Studio's AI Helpers Get More Keys
stories.dek: Your agent can now set up game passes and read analytics. You decide which doors it opens.
paras: Roblox Creators announced that Studio's MCP capabilities are expanding to Open Cloud. You can use your preferred AI agent to set up developer products and game passes, change game settings, read analytics and import assets.
You choose what the agent can access in each game, and three new Skills teach it how. The robots may now price your game passes. Please check their math.
